script_text: Stop! Pisces, the cosmos are screaming loudly at you right now. Mars is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Neptune in the 9th House. This is creating intense friction between your deepest spiritual truths and your harsh practical actions in your daily life today. Venus in Leo is sextiling your 5th House of Romance, sparking a bold new attraction that demands you finally step out of your passive emotional comfort zone and take a massive chance on someone completely unexpected. Saturn is conjunct your Midheaven in the 10th House of Career. You must apply serious discipline and strategic patience to secure a major financial advancement and stabilize your long-term professional reputation successfully moving forward. Avoid making impulsive promises you cannot keep, as the cosmic waters are currently too volatile for reckless commitments today. Follow for the reading of tomorrow before the planetary alignment shifts completely again.
